provenance: A sharp unit-fixed criterion characterizes when a star-reversible ring satisfies the projection-based pro-star-reversible condition introduced in arXiv:2609.20076.
limitations: The pro-star-reversible notion is very recent and the criterion has a short proof once the unit substitution is identified, so concurrent or differently worded coverage remains possible. The current arXiv v1 and the relevant 2013 star-reversible prior art were inspected. No independent validation is asserted.
